answer_1.quote: Finally, it uses this clustering as silver-standard supervision to bootstrap a neural transducer that generates the desired target inflections. That is, the model posits forms to realize unoccupied cell slots in each proposed paradigm.
answer_1.outputs: unseen inflected forms (e.g., past tense, plural forms) to fill empty slots in morphological paradigms

answer_2.quote: We propose a set of PDP metrics, to measure how well organized lexicon forms are in the grid, and a set of PCFP metrics, to measure how well the system anticipates unattested inflectional variants.
